# WageGrid

> US occupational wages by metro, from BLS OEWS May 2025.

WageGrid is a static site. Every wage is an official OEWS estimate. Suppressed cells are blank. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed.

Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025.
Survey: https://www.bls.gov/oes/

## Metros

- Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX (`12420`): /metros/austin-round-rock-san-marcos-tx/
- Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN (`16980`): /metros/chicago-naperville-elgin-il-in/
- Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA (`42660`): /metros/seattle-tacoma-bellevue-wa/
